com.esignal.jstandard.managers.dbc

Class DbcFlexDataField

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.esignal.jstandard.managers.dbc.DbcFlexDataField
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    FlexDataField, java.lang.Iterable<FlexDataField>

    public class DbcFlexDataField
extends java.lang.Object
implements FlexDataField
    A Flexible Data Field which represents a single data field or a composite data field that is composed of one or more FlexDataFields. For instance a TickEvent may have a FlexDataField that represents a single value such as bid_price, or a BarEvent may have a composite FlexDataFieldvalue such as bid_price that is composed of other values such as open, high, low, close, volume.
    • Use getName() to get the name of the field.
    • Use getType() to get the FlexData.DATATYPE of the field.
      • If the type is FlexData.DATATYPE.COMPOSITE, isIterable() will return true and you will use iterator() to get a Iterator<FlexDataField> on which you will iterate the fields that compose this Flexible Data Field.
      • If the type is FlexData.DATATYPE.UNKNOWN, use getRawType() and getValueAsByteBuffer() or getValueAsByteArray() to get the raw bytes. Contact ICE Data Services for information on how to decode the raw type.
      • Else, use the appropriate getValueAs* method for the FlexData.DATATYPE returned from getType(). For instance if getType() returns FlexData.DATATYPE.INT64 use getValueAsInteger().
    Since:
    01-024-0000
    Author:
    ICE Data Services
    See Also:
    FlexData
